author: Ogrey
body:
Hey people! It's been a long while ever since I made a map, and trust me I had no idea what to do when I first started xD It's as if I had forgotten completly how to build!
But thanks to a piece of paper and a pen, I could finally get a decent sketch and I decided to make a map out of it :D

This map is called Sector Six. Named after a map that rotates on a Team Fortress 2 modded server, Slender Fortress. The basic idea of this map is to bring back a rather interesting feature old maps from MCzone used to have. No middle island. As well as addition to gameplay features. This being enchantment rooms (enchantment tables are protected) and no diamonds, there's just iron for you!

Map Name: Ipsen's Castle
Map Creator: Evocal
Basic Info:
Orange vs Cyan (25 vs 25)
3 Monuments
Enchantment Tables (XP Bottles on Spawn + Kill)
6 Iron Farms
No diamonds

Map Images:
